svg.aria-label: Original plot of the mass-concentration column in the NIST SRM 1643f certificate, converted from μg/L to mg/L by division by 1000. Error bars are certified expanded uncertainties with approximately 95% coverage and the individual factors shown at right, not replicate measurements acquired here. The left axis is logarithmic; the right shows each expanded uncertainty relative to its concentration.
